
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/MrVolleyball/p/19676465" title="发布于 2026-03-06 10:30">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">让 AI 住进飞书：OpenClaw 接入飞书机器人的完整实践</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        在上一篇文章成功部署 OpenClaw 之后，接下来我们让 AI 真正“走进工作流”——接入飞书机器人。本文记录了完整的接入流程，包括飞书应用创建、权限配置、OpenClaw Feishu 插件启用、Pairing 配对机制以及群聊模式配置。最终实现通过飞书私聊或群聊即可与 AI 助手对话
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h2 id="前言">前言</h2>
<p>在上一篇文章成功部署 OpenClaw 之后，接下来我们让 AI 真正“走进工作流”——接入飞书机器人。本文记录了完整的接入流程，包括飞书应用创建、权限配置、OpenClaw Feishu 插件启用、Pairing 配对机制以及群聊模式配置。最终实现通过飞书私聊或群聊即可与 AI 助手对话</p>
<h2 id="接入飞书">接入飞书</h2>
<p>1）登陆到飞书<code>https://open.feishu.cn/app</code></p>
<p><img alt="watermarked-openclaw_feishu_1" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1416773/202603/1416773-20260306101603349-1662157588.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>2）创建机器人，并且拿到app id与app secret</p>
<p><img alt="watermarked-openclaw_feishu_2" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1416773/202603/1416773-20260306101611061-717990702.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>3）权限管理</p>
<p><img alt="watermarked-openclaw_feishu_3" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1416773/202603/1416773-20260306101617608-513571108.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>将该段配置复制进去</p>
<pre><code>{
  "scopes": {
    "tenant": [
      "aily:file:read",
      "aily:file:write",
      "application:application.app_message_stats.overview:readonly",
      "application:application:self_manage",
      "application:bot.menu:write",
      "contact:user.employee_id:readonly",
      "corehr:file:download",
      "event:ip_list",
      "im:chat.access_event.bot_p2p_chat:read",
      "im:chat.members:bot_access",
      "im:message",
      "im:message.group_at_msg:readonly",
      "im:message.p2p_msg:readonly",
      "im:message:readonly",
      "im:message:send_as_bot",
      "im:resource"
    ],
    "user": [
      "aily:file:read",
      "aily:file:write",
      "im:chat.access_event.bot_p2p_chat:read"
    ]
  }
}
</code></pre>
<p>4）enable飞书插件</p>
<pre><code>openclaw plugins enable feishu
</code></pre>
<p>5）添加channel</p>
<pre><code>openclaw channels add
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>
<p>选择飞书渠道，并且配置相关的app id与app secret</p>
<p><img alt="watermarked-openclaw_feishu_4" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1416773/202603/1416773-20260306101625285-1464535337.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>由于在国内，选择国内domain就好</p>
<p><img alt="watermarked-openclaw_feishu_5" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1416773/202603/1416773-20260306101632832-1352186106.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>这一步先关闭群聊，等私聊配置之后再来配置群聊也不迟</p>
<p><img alt="watermarked-openclaw_feishu_6" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1416773/202603/1416773-20260306101638650-978112608.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>主要用于配置访问策略，选择默认策略pairing</p>
<p><img alt="watermarked-openclaw_feishu_7" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1416773/202603/1416773-20260306101657937-1947751874.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<ul>
<li>pairing (默认)， 配对模式。 陌生人发消息 → 机器人自动回复一个8位配对码 → 你用 openclaw pairing approve 批准后，对方才能继续对话</li>
<li>open，开放模式。任何人发消息都能直接和 AI 对话，完全不设防。</li>
<li>allowlist，白名单模式。只有你提前配置好的用户 ID 才能发消息，其他所有人一律被拒。</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p>6）事件与回调，配置长连接</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>配置订阅<br>
<img alt="watermarked-openclaw_feishu_8" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1416773/202603/1416773-20260306101706359-828205347.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="watermarked-openclaw_feishu_9" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1416773/202603/1416773-20260306101711469-473993208.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>添加事件<br>
<img alt="watermarked-openclaw_feishu_10" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1416773/202603/1416773-20260306101717829-1351864179.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>7）配置完成，在飞书中发布机器人<br>
<img alt="watermarked-openclaw_feishu_11" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1416773/202603/1416773-20260306101723497-1074183389.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="watermarked-openclaw_feishu_12" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1416773/202603/1416773-20260306101728732-1410572122.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>8）开始测试</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>在飞书中搜索机器人</p>
<p><img alt="watermarked-openclaw_feishu_13" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1416773/202603/1416773-20260306101736255-1680723072.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>尝试与其对话</p>
<p><img alt="watermarked-openclaw_feishu_14" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1416773/202603/1416773-20260306101741862-2016363696.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>回到控制授权</p>
</li>
</ul>
<pre><code>&gt; openclaw pairing approve feishu DPCMW99M
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>再次对话</li>
</ul>
<p><img alt="watermarked-openclaw_feishu_15" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1416773/202603/1416773-20260306101746624-924636164.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2 id="开启群聊">开启群聊</h2>
<p>1）配置openclaw的飞书群聊</p>
<pre><code>&gt; cat ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json | jq '.channels'
{
  "feishu": {
    ...
    "groupPolicy": "open",
    "requireMention": "true"
  }
}
</code></pre>
<p>2）飞书app授权</p>
<p><img alt="watermarked-openclaw_feishu_16" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1416773/202603/1416773-20260306101754541-430940895.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>3）结果测试</p>
<p><img alt="watermarked-openclaw_feishu_17" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1416773/202603/1416773-20260306101800495-1083666201.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2 id="联系我">联系我</h2>
<ul>
<li>联系我，做深入的交流</li>
</ul>
<p><img alt="" width="500" height="200" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1416773/202411/1416773-20241121135740959-1907948957.png#" class="lazyload"></p>
<hr>
<p>至此，本文结束<br>
在下才疏学浅，有撒汤漏水的，请各位不吝赐教...</p>
